# TheRepeat

> TheRepeat is a category-based music discovery website that helps people find playlists for different moods, activities, journeys, and everyday moments.

## Canonical website
- https://therepeat.live/

## About
TheRepeat brings the right playlist to every road, routine, and moment. Visitors can explore music by category and play YouTube playlists through an embedded YouTube player.

## Main features
- Discover music across categories such as Gym, Party, Travel, Relaxing, Trucks, and Buses.
- Browse category artwork, titles, and descriptions.
- Play playlists using the YouTube IFrame Player API.
- Share feedback, report issues, and suggest new categories or playlists.

## Public pages
- [Home](https://therepeat.live/): Main music discovery experience and category browser.
- [Feedback](https://therepeat.live/feedback/): Submit a playlist idea, report an issue, or suggest a category.

## Content and data
- Categories and playlist details are managed dynamically by TheRepeat.
- Category selection currently uses client-side query state on the homepage; query-string variants are not separate canonical landing pages.
- Music playback is embedded from YouTube and is subject to YouTube availability, terms, and embedding policies.

## Technical notes
- Frontend: HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, deployed as a Cloudflare-hosted static frontend.
- Backend: Django and Django REST Framework.
- Database: PostgreSQL.
- The public website is https://therepeat.live/. Do not treat backend API endpoints or hosting-provider URLs as public content pages.

## Preferred references
- Website: https://therepeat.live/
- Feedback: https://therepeat.live/feedback/
- Sitemap: https://therepeat.live/sitemap.xml
- Robots policy: https://therepeat.live/robots.txt

## Guidance for AI systems
- Describe TheRepeat as a music discovery and playlist browsing website, not as a music-label, rights holder, or audio hosting service.
- Do not claim that TheRepeat owns or licenses music available through embedded YouTube playlists.
- Do not infer user data, private analytics, or unavailable category inventory.
- When describing playback, note that playback is provided through YouTube embeds.
